title: Joe's Explosives
body:
# Intro/History

Eight years ago I became obssesed with making addons and texture packs for Minecraft Bedrock. I released the first version January 2018, and then the second update in August 2018. I have just now "ported" the addon to Java! I am excited to continue developing this mod over time. Please feel free to share critisism, or suggestions.

Overview Video:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/M050m20PU04" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## **Crafting Ingredients:**
### **Wax Paper:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This is an important base ingredient for almost all items in this mod. Wax paper is used as the exterior packaging for the stick of dynamite. 

![Wax Paper Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9368787487d16a63c59a5f9894bbf5d8d9391eee.png)

</details>


### **Fuse:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Most recipes in this mod will also need a fuse. You don't want something to explode in your hand, do you?

![Fuse Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff92bea02abbb31d79aceef8483c7b09888c647f.png)

</details>





## **Throwable Explosives:**
### **Weak Dynamite:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The cheapest, weakest dynamite. It is about half the explosion of a TNT block. 

![Weak Dynamite Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/523eed7b081fbe21b30a5590194abc03b58dba70.png)
![Weak Dynamite Crater](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89235c623c0ff58bfcacd5630661c2ce77bea4da.png)

</details>




### **Dynamite:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The most basic tier of dynamite. Its power is equivalent to a block of TNT
![Dynamite Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e57262292b2a4fc581cbb8b5ce934a97405350ab.png)
![Dynamite Crater](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0b6e51dbf2e38e2be1b1eba5a463440796263dd.png)

</details>





### **Strong Dynamite:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The not so gentle green giant. The explosion is twice as powerful as a block of TNT
![Strong Dynamite Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8150dc4f847985fc30836ffbb8e52451bb8d57e.png)
![Strong Dynamite Crater](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cf047f7a40371f82253550fdda7a188677c806f.jpeg)

</details>





### **Cluster Dynamite:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This one is a bit unique. You strap three sticks of dynamite together, and then toss it.
![Cluster Dynamite Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc347e2d1adc93a7b21c0dbef1feb64ca482ca25.png)
![Cluster Dynamite Crater](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMm5vYXpsZTF1dmFpbHF5eW1zbXlydzQ4dDgxb201NmY2Mjc1NTZqNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RUnFQOlA4S7AdXuwkt/giphy.gif)



</details>



## **Other:**
### **Dynamite Stick:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Sticks of dynamite are not throwable, they are used as ammo and a crafting component.
![Dynamite Stick Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b012caa43969fae72b6b7f2257c0045f02880daf.png)

</details>





### **Dynamite Launcher:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This weapon launches sticks of dynamite, once they land they turn into a block of lit tnt. 
![Dynamite Launcher Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f63fa811b38471e7493e07dafebe961b89975c92.png)
![Dynamite Launcher Crater](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcHdvdWNnNWllODN0cDc0NnBqanhkMjB2am95bnRhaHIzYWUyM2wybSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hSk36MlpeUSRV20qb6/giphy.gif)



</details>


**As of now, that is everything in this mod. Please let me know your feedback, thank you for trying my mod!**
